proposal: Partition inference attention by heads across bounded existing worker lanes. Reuse one page-rounded score buffer per lane; preserve arithmetic within every head and all KV values.
host: Apple M4 / 24 GiB / Go 1.27.1 / four threads and workers
micro: Synthetic Mistral geometry 4096 dim,32 heads,8 KV heads; 1/2/16 rows, prefix lengths 128/2048/8192; paired/reversed samples; retained old attention callback.
full_model: Pinned local Mistral7B v0.3 Q4-mixed; short control and continuous 256-output-ID core decode, real KV built only by model forward; identical harness, ABBA order, one model resident. Long trajectory is fixed-step even at EOS, with actual text generation separately checked.

acceptance.score_scratch_bound: at most min(worker count,rows*heads,256) * page-rounded context * 4 bytes, subject to total workspace budget
acceptance.score_reallocations: at most one per KV page while layout is unchanged

limits: Bounded host-specific engineering gates, not broad quality or throughput claims. Preserve failed attempts. No concurrent heavy work during speed probes. Do not alter model files or quantization.

full_model_settings.notes: Fixed before real-model measurements. Two complete long trajectories per variant, fresh KV each. Model is reloaded per process; one resident model. Long prefill and decode timed separately.
